description: Library Maintenance's duplicate groups on the Duplicates tab, as admin, on the desktop (1366 px), on two phones (375 and 320 px) and on jellyfin-web's TV layout. The groups the page shows are the ones GET /LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Groups gives (the count, the first card, its suggested keep first, Open to its details page); each entry's poster is the movie's own image when the server has one (asked with no tag, through ApiClient.getUrl, so under the base URL) and its initials when it has none, in a 60 x 90 px box that never moves; Title only asks for them again and is kept over a reload (localStorage jflm:duplicates.view); the Conflict filter keeps only its groups; nothing scrolls sideways on a phone; on the TV the D-pad goes from the tabs to Rebuild, the groups' controls and a card's Open, never the drawer, and OK on Open opens the movie. Changes nothing on the server (the index is built once if the server has none); this browser's kept choices and layout are removed at the end.
